title: PRISM/CY — P: Posture
description: Describes where the enterprise stands — compliance framework status, security maturity, open programs, and audit findings. Posture synthesizes the other four dimensions.

framework.description: Compliance or security framework this artifact relates to.

status.description: Lifecycle status. For compliance artifacts: certified | in-progress | applicable | exempt.

maturity_level.description: Security maturity rating for this artifact or domain.

certification_date.description: Date certification or audit was completed (compliance artifacts).

next_audit.description: Next scheduled audit or re-certification date.

target_date.description: Target completion date for in-progress compliance or program artifacts.

open_gaps.description: Documented open gaps for this compliance or maturity artifact.

depends_on.description: IDs of threat or finding artifacts this program is addressing.

as_of.description: Date this dimension file accurately reflected the security posture.

compliance.description: Compliance framework status artifacts: GDPR, SOX, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS.

maturity_assessments.description: Security maturity scores against a framework domain or control category.

security_programs.description: Active security remediation or improvement programs.

findings.description: Open findings from audits, penetration tests, or CSPM scans.
